# agent-sandbox

> Policy guard for agent shell commands: allow-listed absolute executables, path roots, process-tree timeout, capped output and scrubbed environment Python package `trysac-agent-sandbox`, import name `agent_sandbox`, MIT licensed,
> Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.

- [Testing](docs/TESTING.md): how to run and extend the tests
